description.en-US:
VaultZero is an offline, zero-knowledge password manager. The APK has no
INTERNET permission, no account, no analytics and no crash reporting.

Records are encrypted with AES-256-GCM (bound to id and type via AAD); the vault
master key is wrapped with Argon2id (64 MiB, t=3) password and recovery-phrase
envelopes, with transparent migration from older PBKDF2 vaults. Recovery uses
BIP-39 12-word kits; backups are encrypted, verified, duplicate-safe files
written through the Android Storage Access Framework.

This repository is the Cipherwell beta channel. Every build here is signed with
the same VaultZero upload key; updates install over the previous version.

English and Spanish (US) UI, MIT licence.
